_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The drawer truncates long slugs to one line with an ellipsis. The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list and cut off its live update stream, so there is nothing to set up, intercept or check about that (do not look at the API): the drawer (".drawer") shows the conversations the test names, as rows [data-conversation-id="<id>"] whose title (".conversation-title") is their slug, which is their id (drafts have none), and whose preview is "Preview". The list is "{{LONG}}" and "short". "The long title" is "[data-conversation-id=\"{{LONG}}\"] .conversation-title" and "the short title" is "[data-conversation-id=\"short\"] .conversation-title". Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is the element with role button (a <button>) whose accessible name (aria-label, else its text) is exactly X; "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The long title's text is exactly "{{LONG}}" and its title attribute is exactly "{{LONG}}". 3. It does not wrap: the long title's getBoundingClientRect().height equals exactly the short title's. 4. Overflowing content is clipped with an ellipsis rather than wrapped: for the long title, eval JSON.stringify({clipped: el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth, textOverflow: getComputedStyle(el).textOverflow}) must be exactly {"clipped":true,"textOverflow":"ellipsis"}.

steps.expression: (function(){ var longEl = document.querySelector('[data-conversation-id="{{LONG}}"] .conversation-title'); var shortEl = document.querySelector('[data-conversation-id="short"] .conversation-title'); return String(longEl.getBoundingClientRect().height === shortEl.getBoundingClientRect().height); })()

(function(){ var el = document.querySelector('[data-conversation-id="{{LONG}}"] .conversation-title'); return JSON.stringify({clipped: el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth, textOverflow: getComputedStyle(el).textOverflow}); })()
